description: This file defines a class AdmonitionRenderer which implements the NodeRendererInterface for rendering admonition blocks in a Markdown-to-Confluence converter, specifically handling different admonition types and rendering their content as HTML elements.

classes.name: AdmonitionRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class responsible for converting admonition nodes into Confluence-compatible HTML elements, adapting admonition types and rendering titles and content appropriately.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an admonition node into an HTML structure suitable for Confluence, handling different types and including title and content elements.
